name: flow
description: Flow: AI reel editor for DaVinci Resolve. /flow cuts silences and bad takes, adds captions, punch-ins, hooks, titles, looks, speed ramps and effects, or finishes a timeline from its markers and placeholders. Shortcuts: /flow:reel, /flow:finish, /flow:tweak, /flow:undo, /flow:render, /flow:status, /flow:broll, /flow:styles, /flow:teach, /flow:check.
